How many dishes are available at Aroma Buffet?
Aroma Buffet offers over 100 individual items across its buffet selection. Dishes may vary between lunch and dinner and can change according to availability and seasonal rotation.
What cuisines are available at Aroma Buffet?
Our buffet brings together Chinese favourites, Japanese sushi, Malaysian and Thai flavours, Indian curries, rice and noodle dishes, teppanyaki and desserts.
Does Aroma Buffet serve sushi?
Yes. Our buffet includes a rotating selection of sushi and sashimi. Availability may differ between lunch and dinner.
Does Aroma Buffet offer vegetarian dishes?
Yes. The buffet usually includes salads, vegetable stir-fries, tofu dishes, rice, noodles, chickpea masala and tarka dal. Please speak to our team about ingredients and dietary requirements.

Samba Bottomless Brunch in Paddington
Bottomless Brunch London: Samba Brunch in Paddington | Ayllu

Bottomless brunch in London is everywhere: unlimited prosecco, a fixed menu, ninety minutes, next table please. Most of them are interchangeable. Ayllu's is not. Every Saturday and Sunday in Paddington Central we run a ninety-minute Samba Bottomless Brunch: unlimited Nikkei Japanese-Peruvian sharing plates, free-flowing drinks and a live Samba show. If you are looking for the best bottomless brunc
What's Included in Ayllu's Bottomless Brunch

Two packages, both running for ninety minutes. £37pp is bottomless food only: unlimited Nikkei sharing plates for the full sitting, ceviche, sushi uramaki rolls, appetisers, mains and dessert, all designed to share. £55pp is bottomless food and drinks: everything above plus free-flowing drinks for the full session. Choose from house white wine, house red wine, prosecco or the cocktail of the week.
Book · Samba Brunch: Bottomless Food
